Men's Comfort Quarter Zip

The quarter zip you'll keep wearing long after the round. Soft French terry with four-way stretch and enough breathability for a cool day on the course.

  • 8.5 oz. 60/35/5 cotton/polyester/spandex
  • 4-way stretch French terry
  • Moisture-wicking
  • Pre-washed to reduce shrinkage
  • Cadet collar and reverse coil zipper

Part of Consider, the Hesedea golf line rooted in Psalm 107:43: "let them Consider the Hesed of the Lord."

Made to order. Each piece is made when you order it and typically ships in about a week. We'll email tracking as soon as it's on the way.

Net proceeds from every Hesedea purchase support Mully Children’s Family, caring for orphaned and vulnerable children in Kenya.
